statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-27135 (GHSA-6933-cjhr-5qg6): before nghttp2 1.68.1 the library keeps reading input after nghttp2_session_terminate_session() or nghttp2_session_terminate_session2() is called, so a malformed frame that triggers FRAME_SIZE_ERROR hits an assertion and aborts the process. It was fixed upstream in commit https://github.com/nghttp2/nghttp2/commit/5c7df8fa815ac1004d9ecb9d1f7595c4d37f46e1 ('Fix missing iframe->state validations to avoid assertion failure'), released in nghttp2 1.68.1 (https://github.com/nghttp2/nghttp2/releases/tag/v1.68.1). Alpine's security database lists CVE-2026-27135 as fixed in nghttp2 1.68.1. This owner builds each version from the upstream release tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 repository publishes 1.68.0-r0, 1.68.1-r0, 1.69.0-r0, 1.70.0-r0 and 1.71.0-r0 on x86_64 and aarch64. We read the libnghttp2 library in nghttp2-libs on both architectures: 1.68.0-r0 reports version 1.68.0 and 1.68.1-r0 reports 1.68.1. 1.68.0-r0 is affected, and 1.68.1-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-27135 (GHSA-6933-cjhr-5qg6): before nghttp2 1.68.1 the library keeps reading input after nghttp2_session_terminate_session() or nghttp2_session_terminate_session2() is called, so a malformed frame that triggers FRAME_SIZE_ERROR hits an assertion and aborts the process. It was fixed upstream in commit https://github.com/nghttp2/nghttp2/commit/5c7df8fa815ac1004d9ecb9d1f7595c4d37f46e1 ('Fix missing iframe->state validations to avoid assertion failure'), released in nghttp2 1.68.1 (https://github.com/nghttp2/nghttp2/releases/tag/v1.68.1). Alpine's security database lists CVE-2026-27135 as fixed in nghttp2 1.68.1. This owner builds each version from the upstream release tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 repository publishes 1.68.0-r0, 1.68.1-r0, 1.69.0-r0, 1.70.0-r0 and 1.71.0-r0 on x86_64 and aarch64. We read the libnghttp2 library in nghttp2-libs on both architectures: 1.68.0-r0 reports version 1.68.0 and 1.68.1-r0 reports 1.68.1. 1.68.0-r0 is affected, and 1.68.1-r0 and later carry the fix.
